author: ojiudezue
title: v5.103.31 shipped: Night lights go red at sleep on colour lights
summary: Night lights go red at sleep on colour lights
why: The operator wanted night lights in a red shade to protect sleep. URA's 2000 K default is amber, not red, because kelvin cannot produce red; the house's own HA night automations already use RGB 255,30,10, so URA now matches them on colour lights while white-only lights keep the warmest white.
implications: Shipped ROOM-LIGHTING-SETUP-REDESIGN-1 at v5.103.31; card(s) sit shipped_organic pending validation. Acceptance in README_v5.103.31.md (Live criteria).
revisit_trigger: If a colour night light is not red at sleep, or a white-only light errors on the colour call, reopen.

refs.release_notes: In Sleep mode, colour-capable night lights turn on deep red RGB (255,30,10), matching the house's own night automations; white-only lights keep 2000 K. New per-room choice 'Night-light colour at sleep': Red (default) / Warm white.
